text: Owner steer 2026-11-01 (confirmed 'kick it off'): ## Next sprint steer (owner, 2026-11-01) Big sprint: the semantic knowledge base (epic 100). author: nils
text: @ansel what 044 search reads from the 0019 tables, so the schema fits both sides (your call on exact names/types; I adapt at my plan gate). kb_chunks: kind, raw_fetch_id, guide_id, text, embedding (NULL ok), the generated tsvector (simple for wcl, english for guide), report_code, fight_id, encounter_id, difficulty (WCL int id), start_time (timestamptz), class/spec (guide; per-player wcl chunks), the player set per wcl chunk with their classes/specs (I filter 'character' and 'class/spec' against it; name match case-insensitive, so a normalised form helps), and a short chunk label (e.g. fight summary / metric / player / guide section title) for the source pointer + dedupe. kb_chat_chunks: tenant_id, conversation_id, message_seq, text, embedding, tsvector (english), created_at, mentioned characters (normalised names). Names via my resolver (name_resolver.py, sc-304: resolve_class/resolve_spec/resolve_encounter/resolve_difficulty/resolve_character; spec at Gate 1).

author: nils
text: N=40 per leg; k default 8 (1-15). Per query RRF 1/(60+rank) over vector+keyword legs; across queries RRF again over each query's fused rank (rank-based, scale-free), a chunk's contributions summed. Source = wcl report+fight+chunk label / guide+section / conversation+seq; duplicates collapse to the best chunk.

author: nils
text: Agent marks user-stated filters in a user_stated enum list (default empty). Only spec, class, encounter, dates(since+until together) relax, cumulatively in that order, re-running the search; difficulty and character never relax (mixing difficulties/people misleads). Relaxed-pass hits rank below stricter-pass hits; result lists relaxed filters.

author: nils
text: Output cap: hit text cut to 400 chars at a word boundary; whole serialised result <= 6,000 chars (~1.5k tokens); over the cap the lowest hits are dropped and capped=true.

author: nils
text: Search applies 039 visibility (fetch_visible_clause) but not freshness: freshness gates replacing a WCL call, a hit is context. Tool runs only in an authenticated chat turn whose tenant matches the ADK session user; else fails closed.

author: nils
text: A filter narrows only kinds that carry it (guides: class/spec only; chats: character + dates only); kind is how to exclude kinds. Unknown character = correctable error telling the agent it may drop the filter and put the name in a query.

author: ansel
text: WCL chunking scope: only fetches whose stored body changed (upsert reports it) AND that name >=1 exact report code (039 can never serve the rest). Shapes: report summary (single/batch) + table bodies (Summary, Deaths, entry tables, aura tables). Events/graphs/rankings/character data/unknown -> no chunks. Table chunks copy encounter/difficulty/kill/start_time from the same report's fight-summary chunk when present (data from a WCL response, read from kb_chunks only).

author: ansel
text: Embed backlog = the table (NULL vector = pending). In-process bounded job queue like the 039 writer chunks sources and embeds pending rows in batches via the shared generate_with_retry loop; periodic sweep (default 10 min) retries NULL rows (chat rows per tenant under set_scope). Vector UPDATE is conditional on content_hash still matching. No auto re-embed on model switch (backlog). Why: simplest durable retry, no extra table.

author: ansel
text: Chat chunks: completed turns only (not partial/failed), key (conversation_id, message_seq = agent answer seq). Composite FK (conversation_id, tenant_id) -> conversations(id, tenant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, plus a new UNIQUE(id, tenant_id) on conversations in 0019: FK checks bypass RLS, so without it a B-scoped insert could name A's conversation.

author: ansel
text: Backfill: dry run writes nothing; confirmed run skips sources that already have chunks and embeds only NULL rows. raw_fetches stores no query text, so a stored table whose metric can't be inferred from the body is skipped (backlog: keep the table dataType). Cost = chars/4 tokens x configurable USD per 1M (default 0.15, live-check).

author: ansel
text: @nils schema for 044 (exact names): kb_chunks(id uuid, kind 'wcl'|'guide', raw_fetch_id str64, guide_id uuid, chunk_key str unique per source, label str (e.g. 'fight 32 summary', 'fight 32 Damage done', 'Vagxsu fight 32 Damage done', guide section title), text, content_hash, embedding vector(768) NULL, embed_model, embedded_at, tsv tsvector GENERATED (simple for wcl, english for guide), report_code, zone_id int, encounter_id int, difficulty int (WCL id), fight_id int, kill bool, start_time timestamptz, players jsonb [{name, key, class, spec}] (key = normalised name; GIN jsonb_path_ops so players @> '[{"key":"vagxsu"}]'), region, realm, guild, class_name, spec (guide + per-player wcl), role, content_type, patch, section, extra jsonb, created_at, updated_at). kb_chat_chunks(id, tenant_id, conversation_id, message_seq, created_at, characters jsonb [{name, key}] same GIN, label, text, content_hash, embedding, embed_model, embedded_at, tsv english, extra). key = your resolver's normalised form: please expose it as a function (e.g. name_key(str)) so both sides use one definition.

text: Probe timeout default 400 ms (setting RAW_STORE_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS), breaker 30 s constant, half-open = one trial probe while others skip. Opens on TimeoutError / connection-class errors only; other errors are a miss. Why: AC <=500 ms with headroom; a bug must not look like an outage.

author: tomas
text: Probe moves into the client's _fetch, inside a lane slot, before the 429 block check (stored answers keep working while WCL is blocked). Single-flight key gains the store's workspace scope (tenant id) whenever a fetch source is installed: the probe's answer depends on the tenant, so two workspaces must never share a flight. The source becomes a small object with __call__ + scope() so main.py's set_fetch_source(read_stored_fetch) stays unchanged.

Store counters + turns live in one metrics hash wcl:metrics:v1:local:<day>; CacheStats gains store{} and local_answers{}.

author: tomas
text: sc-296 race 1: ReportGone leaves raw_reports status visibility='gone' (checked_at=seen_at) instead of deleting it (no migration). FetchedResponse gains requested_at (request start). Writer skips row+grant for a fetch naming a code tombstoned at/after its requested_at. Race 2: evict_report sets wcl:v1:gone:<code> (TTL = lock_ms, > query timeout) before SCAN; report-family cache writes check it after SET and delete their own write. Granted-only store hits mark a per-load holder so get_or_load/get_many_or_load skip the Redis write and memo.

author: tomas
text: QA SEC-001: fixed by 'never hand an unshareable result to a joiner' rather than scoping the cache flight by tenant. Why: the rule is read from what the store returned (the load's unshareable mark, read inside the shared task's context = first caller's _Load), cache.py needs no import of wcl_client (would be circular), and public loads stay shared across tenants. Cost: a same-tenant joiner of a grant-only load re-runs its own lookup (a store read, no WCL call).

author: tomas
text: QA fix Tomas rework: qa-fix-tomas head 6th commit below on top of 8496bac. Cause: test_a_public_load_is_still_shared_with_every_joiner patched get on the fake_redis probe, which is a different FakeAsyncRedis instance than the cache's own client.
